newsitem.title: USA: Wm. Wrigley '96 sales up on price, volume.
newsitem.headline: Wm. Wrigley '96 sales up on price, volume.

text.p: Wm. Wrigley Jr Co said on Thursday that net sales for 1996 rose to $1.84 billion from $1.75 billion in 1995 due to higher volumes overseas and selected selling price rises, mainly in Europe and North America.

These gains were partially offset by translation of foreign current sales into U.S. dollars at lower average exchange rates. Full-year 1996 investment and other income amounted to $14.6 million for total revenues of $1.85 billion. In 1995, investment and other income amounted to $14.8 million for total revenues of $1.77 billion.

In the fourth quarter, sales were $463.3 million, up from $442.6 million a year ago and investment and other income rose to $4.4 million from $3.4 million. Total revenues for the quarter were $467.7 million, up from $446.0 million.

Earlier, Wrigley reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.47 a share, including a charge of $924,000 related to a factory closure in Santa Cruaz, Calif. In the 1995 quarter, it earned $0.40 a share. For the year, Wrigley earned $1.99 a share, after $19.4 million in factory closure and related costs, up from $1.93 a year ago.
